explication: Apache CloudStack is an IaaS platform for deploying and managing virtual machines and their surrounding cloud resources. Users initiate management through the web UI, CLI, or query-based API; the platform exposes management capabilities and orchestrates compute, networking, and storage across supported hypervisors. The tree and README establish these product areas, but the sampled source does not show the full runtime call chain, so implementation links beyond documented capabilities are marked unverified rather than asserted.
